messages:
Asha (GTM): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: partner pipeline + exec ask. I'll drop bullets, pls reply inline.
Maya (Sales): ready. short answers please.
Asha (GTM): 1) partner vs direct split for new pipeline this qtr? ballpark % ok.
Jules (RevOps): ~25% partner-influenced by value, up from ~15% qtr prior.
Diego (Partnerships): note: 7 active partner-led opps > $100k, 2 in legal review.
Asha (GTM): 2) routing: SDR first or AE direct for referrals? what do we want?
Diego (Partnerships): default SDR. propose rule: referral_score >=8 => AE direct.
Jules (RevOps): can implement CRM rule + calendar-fallback (AE busy -> primary SDR). low lift.
Maya (Sales): add SLA: AE first-touch <=48h for high-intent referrals.
Asha (GTM): 3) attribution: execs want partner attribution in weekly ops and usage export. doable?
Nina (Product): we emit X-Partner-Id at runtime; persisting to usage export is a 1-sprint ETL change + 1 analytics sprint.
Jules (RevOps): once persisted I'll wire it into the partner health card. include partner display name & tier mapping.
Asha (GTM): 4) pilot readiness slide for execs 1 slide. must-haves?
Sam (Legal): include data handling summary, SOC2 status, subprocessors, DPA/DPA addendum state. label as "pilot-fasttrack".
Maya (Sales): include POC timeline, conversion criteria, required co-marketing, and sandbox latency expectations.
Diego (Partnerships): I'll draft slide and a short checklist template.
Asha (GTM): action items: Diego -> slide + checklist (Wed EOD). Nina -> schedule export change (confirm sprint by Tue). Jules -> CRM rule + dashboard card (Thu). Sam -> SOC2/DPA check (48h). Maya -> update sales playbook SLA.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly partner health -> #partners Mondays 9:00am PT.
Priya (CEO): thanks team 44d keep it concise for exec sync.
Maya (Sales): on it.
